lines.text: Jealousy and selfish ambition bring disorder and every evil practice, and that wisdom is earthly, unspiritual, and demonic.
The wisdom from above is pure and peace-loving, and peacemakers who sow in peace reap the fruit of the Spirit.
Conflicts come from passions at war within, and God opposes the proud but gives grace to the humble.
Submit to God and resist the devil, and he will flee; humble yourselves before the Lord, and He will exalt you.
Do not slander one another, for there is one Lawgiver and Judge, able to kill and make alive.
